instruction.text: Build the name of the country.

hint.text: The official name of this country is the Republic of Colombia.
hint.sound: The official name of this country is the Republic of Columbia.
hint.label: Official name

instruction.text: What do you know about Colombia? Complete the fact file.
What does the flag of Colombia look like?
Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Cumbia, which is a cheerful music and dance, comes from Colombia and is enjoyed by many people.
atoms.sound: Coombia, which is a cheerful music and dance, comes from Columbia and is enjoyed by many people.

atoms.a: Colombia has a higher diversity of bird species than any other country in the world. These species range from tiny hummingbirds to toucans with their bright orange beaks.
atoms.sound: Columbia has a higher diversity of bird species than any other country in the world. These species range from tiny hummingbirds to toucans with their bright orange beaks.

atoms.a: In Colombia, many people eat arepas, which are round, filled, corn flatbreads.
atoms.sound: In Columbia, many people eat arreppers, which are round, filled, corn flatbreads.

atoms.a: Colombia’s national tree is the tallest palm tree in the world: the wax palm. These can grow up to 60 metres — that’s about as tall as a 20-storey building!
atoms.sound: Columbia’s national tree is the tallest palm tree in the world: the wax palm. These can grow up to 60 metres — that’s about as tall as a 20-storey building!

atoms.b: Part of the Amazon rainforest is in Colombia. It is home to countless animals, such as monkeys, jaguars, sloths and colourful frogs, making it one of the ((++most least)) biodiverse countries in the world.
atoms.sound: Part of the Amazon rainforest is in Columbia. It is home to countless animals, such as monkeys, jaguars, sloths and colourful frogs, making it one of the most biodiverse countries in the world.
